Sub: Revised Intimation of Schedule of call with analyst(s) / institutional investor(s) 
 
Dear Sir/Madam,  
 
In compliance with the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that 
the timing of the analyst(s) / institutional investor(s) call scheduled on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, to discuss the Reviewed 
Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, has been revised from 4:00 PM IST 
to 5:30 PM IST. 
 
The dial-in details for the call are enclosed herewith.  
 
The analyst(s) / institutional investor(s) presentation will be submitted to the Stock Exchanges and hosted on the Company's 
website at www.homefirstindia.com. 
 
We request you to take the above information on record. 
 
For Home First Finance Company India Limited
